about: The cmd:/env: cut (decision Q92), one set of cases for both of its implementations: the CLI's --json (src/roster/jsonout.py, tests/test_json.py) what Plugins get from roster serve (crates/roster-core/src/plugin/runtime.rs, its tests module), and the fake Backend's port of it (app/src/backend/redact.ts, redact.test.ts). A reference starts the text or follows a space, a quote or one of =:,({[, in any case. A cmd: one runs to the end of its line (a closing quote is put back), an env: one is the variable's name; either becomes its kind. A case with "error": true is an error message (redact_error): a trailing (code N) stays. "values" are whole JSON values (redact): every string inside is cut, a key as much as a value. Change a rule here first: all three test suites read this file.
